items.title: 3 Stocks Built on Recurring Revenue That Could Keep Growing for Decades
items.summary: You probably can't name the company that services your office elevator, treats your baseboards, or hauls your dumpster. That anonymity hides businesses customers rarely leave, yet two of these three stocks stumbled this year. What went wrong?

items.title: Waste Management vs. Republic Services: Which Pays Investors More?
items.summary: Two garbage giants just surged about 17% in a month, and both ask income investors to pay up. Yield, cash coverage, and valuation point in different directions, so which one actually rewards a retiree's patience?

items.title: Zacks Investment Ideas feature highlights: Republic Services and Cintas
items.summary: Republic Services and Cintas showcase the appeal of boring stocks, with recurring demand, steady earnings growth and strong stock performance amid market volatility.

items.title: The Beauty Behind 'Boring' Stocks During Market Volatility
items.summary: While tech remains attractive given its growth prospects, less-exciting businesses shouldn't be overlooked, with recurring demand and relatively predictable operations providing a nice level of stability.

items.title: Verisk Analytics Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates, Revenues Jump 5% Y/Y
items.summary: VRSK beats Q3'26 earnings and revenue estimates, driven by strong subscription growth and margin expansion, while cash flow declines sharply.

items.title: Waste and recycling M&A: October recap
items.summary: Waste Dive identified more than a dozen deals that closed in October. They featured a variety of buyers and assets, with many targeting biogas opportunities.

items.title: TransUnion Stock Barely Moves Since Posting Q3 Earnings & Revenue Beat
items.summary: TRU shares barely move despite reporting a Q3 earnings and revenue beat, fueled by U.S. growth and international momentum, as it raises the 2026 EPS outlook.
